notes.title: Update v1.3.1
notes.content:
Hello, Mushroom Warriors!

We've heard your feedback and are ready to present you the v1.3.1 update!

:shroomhooray: Fixed issues with graphics and controls on ultra-wide screens (e.g. 21:9).
:shroomhooray: Added missing localizations for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Turkish languages.
:shroomhooray: Fixed various issues with text overlapping.

As usual, feel free to comment on this update in our Steam group discussions!

notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hey, Mushroom Wars Community!

We've got a special gift for you for the holiday season!
The game has been updated to v1.3.0 with the following changes:

ːshroomhoorayː Added 3 new maps for Skirmish/Multiplayer.
ːshroomhoorayː Added support for setting random map in Custom Game.
ːshroomhoorayː Added support for viewing player profiles by clicking on leaderboard or friends list entries.
ːshroomhoorayː Added showing clouds with troop counts on all buildings while waiting for the game to start (3-2-1-Go).
ːshroomhoorayː Added window flashing when a network game is found.
ːshroomhoorayː Balanced 'Duplex I' map (middle forge now contains 50 units).
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed incorrect weapon position for units that exit from the building to the right or change their direction.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed weapon flickering for units that move to the left.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed unit explosion effect produced by the fireball tower.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed minimap changing on the win-screen in Custom Game when the host has left the match and changes next map.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed texture that highlights own nickname in network game.

Please share your feedback on this update in our Steam group discussions!

notes.title: Update v1.2.0 – Custom Games and More!
notes.content:
Hello, Mushroom Wars Community! ːshroomgladː

We've been working really hard to bring you the feature that was missed so much – Custom Games – along with many other improvements! Meet the update v1.2.0!

ːshroomhoorayː Added Custom Games functionality: create or join parties and enjoy games with up to 4 players and 2 spectators!
ːshroomhoorayː When a player is eliminated and continues watching the game, they will now be able to see troop numbers on all enemy buildings.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed case where multiplayer game wouldn't finish when last opponent disconnects.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed music issue when local player is eliminated.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed game search sound not stopping after game has been found.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed Skirmish difficulty not saving when you exit from the battle.
ːshroomhoorayː Performed minor UI improvements.

Please share your feedback on this update in our Steam group discussions!

notes.title: It’s Your Fungus Troops Versus the World with Mushroom Wars’ Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22342672/fb5c62d08aba93b16f83ada5e925040c23dce8c8.jpg[/img]

Friends, you’ve been waiting for so long – please enjoy:
∙ Online Multiplayer
∙ Ranked Matches
∙ Local Multiplayer
∙ Gamepad Support
 
We have a 20% discount to celebrate this starting from Sunday!
 
Local Multiplayer has been added to Skirmish mode! Now up to four people can put their real-time strategy skills to test playing on the same PC / screen using gamepads. Also in Skirmish, you are now able to choose your race / color before the match.
 
With Online Multiplayer update, you can play with online opponents from all over the world, while private matches will be added in the near future. This update brings along ranked matches, so you can see how you stack up to the competition.
 
Invite your friends over to share this awesome playtime!
 
Thank you so much for your patient support and inspiration.
Yours,
Mushroom Wars Team

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey, Mushroom Wars Community! 

We've been working hard to bring you the new update:

ːshroomhoorayː Fixed crashes caused by Direct3D initialization failure. The game will now prompt to run in safe mode in this case.
ːshroomhoorayː Fixed infinite loading caused by corrupted save file.

We've had reports of the game failing to launch on some systems with XBox controller attached, please try unplugging it before starting the game, while we investigate this issue.

Many thanks for your support, ːshroomgladː ːshroomgladː ːshroomgladː
Mushroom Wars Team

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:

Thanks a lot for your feedback, we've worked on the problems, and here are the news:

ːshroomsmileː We enabled Steam error logging and added support for additional game logging - this should help us resolve the bugs with the crashes you've encountered. If you experience this, please read our "Support" topic.

ːshroomsmileː Fixed Lightning and Perfectionist achievements.

ːshroomsmileː Fixed slowdowns when capturing enemy buildings.

ːshroomsmileː Fixed freeze on level 5.

ːshroomsmileː Potential fix for selecting incorrect default resolution on some systems.

ːshroomsmileː Updated German localizations.

Thank you so much for being with us! ːshroomhoorayː ːshroomhoorayː ːshroomhoorayː

Yours,
Mushroom Wars Team ːshroomarrrghː
